question: In Andhra Pradesh, who is the Chairman of the State Business Advisory Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker of the State Legislature.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The** State Business Advisory Committee** is a body that **assists the Speaker of the State Legislature in conducting the business of the House.**
 
• It is **responsible for preparing the agenda for the proceedings** of the House, **allocating time for the discussion** of various issues, and **coordinating with the government on legislative matters.**
 
• Hence, the** Speaker of the State Legislature **is the natural choice for the **Chairman of the Committee.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Inform
